purpose.zh: 练胸和肩膀，转身的时候腰腹也得稳住
purpose.en: Builds your chest and shoulders, and your middle has to stay solid as you turn.

text.zh: 做一个俯卧撑，再整个人转成侧撑
text.en: Do a push-up, then turn your whole body into a side plank

text.zh: 胸口和胯一起转，像一扇门打开，别光扭腰。
text.en: Turn chest and hips together like a door swinging open, not just your waist.

text.zh: 上面的手指向天花板，停一下再转回来。
text.en: Reach your top hand to the ceiling, pause, then turn back.

text.zh: 往左转一次、往右转一次，才算 1 下。
text.en: A turn to the left plus a turn to the right counts as one.

cautions.zh: 转侧撑时一只手扛全身，手腕先活动开，疼就别转
cautions.en: One hand carries you in the side plank. Warm up your wrists first and skip the turn if they hurt.

cautions.zh: 俯卧撑做不满就跪着做，再转身
cautions.en: Can't manage the push-ups? Do them on your knees, then turn.
